scope: Tunis governorate only. These optional OSM rows are withheld pending defensible names/identity evidence; they are not Ministry imadas.

records.reason: OSM has only landuse=residential and a Latin name. The extent is not identity proof and about 2.83% falls outside current official Attar sector 116454. The Google search was an unrelated doctor POI. This does not prove the locality is absent.
records.evidenceGap: An authoritative Arabic/locality name and a map or boundary tying that name to this exact polygon, including its edge relationship to Attar 116454.

records.reason: OSM tags a small Latin-named residential polygon with official_name=Cité Essalem, but the feature is fully covered by the official INS sector حي السلام, code 115958. Existing evidence cannot resolve whether this is a distinct informal locality or a residential subset. This does not prove the locality is absent.
records.evidenceGap: A municipal or other authoritative source identifying Cité Essalem as a distinct locality and clarifying its Arabic name or relation to sector 115958.

records.reason: OSM explicitly tags place=neighbourhood but supplies only a Latin name and a single point, with no neighborhood polygon. INS identifies only containing sector سيدي عمر, code 117056. This does not prove the locality is absent.
records.evidenceGap: An authoritative Arabic locality name source and, if polygon-based GPS reliability is required, a reviewed neighborhood boundary.

administrativeAndPrayerScope: parentName and the cited INS sector are administrative context; app delegationId is the nearest prayer/meteo delegation and must not be treated as proof of administrative parent or locality identity.
priorMapEvidence: Google Maps searches returned unrelated doctor, housing-complex/residential-area, or bank POIs. They are not locality-boundary evidence and do not resolve these records.
